objective: Read Warosh's Scroll.  Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

description: Take this note!  Get me my mojo!
progress: Ah! Do you have my mojo?
completion: Aha! I can already feel my powers returning to me. And my mind is no longer wracked by Urok's curse.
Thank you, <name>! Humility is below me, but I must acknowledge your aid.
And I bid you fortune in your journeys through Blackrock Spire. You are a fool to think you could make your way to the top, but your bravery is without question.
